channel.title: Jeffrey F. S. Neumann — Archive
channel.description: New works added to the archive of Jeffrey F. S. Neumann

item.title: Untitled 7 (Studio Interior)
item.description: Studio interior photographed through a reflective glass surface, creating layered double-exposure effects. Visible elements include an orange triangle shape on a wall, art supplies, a wire trolley stacked with markers, and ambient incandescent lighting. 1980, Photograph

item.title: Untitled (Studio Wall Collage)
item.description: Studio wall photograph showing the King Crimson 'In the Court of the Crimson King' album cover prominently displayed, with a circular rainbow sticker affixed to its upper left. Surrounding record sleeves and photographs, including a 'Runt' album below, form a dense collage arrangement. 1970, Photograph

item.title: Untitled (Electric Typewriter)
item.description: Studio photograph of a vintage electric typewriter, black and ivory in color, with a sheet of paper loaded into the carriage. Brand markings are partially legible; the machine appears to be in active or recent use. 1980, Photograph

item.title: Untitled (Live Concert Stage)
item.description: Low-angle concert photograph captures three figures on a darkened stage under warm stage lighting. Two guitarists flank a central vocalist; Marshall amplifier stacks are visible in the background. 1970, Photograph

item.title: Untitled (Installation View) 4
item.description: Installation view of a red-walled gallery space featuring iridescent sequined or metallic fabric panels arranged horizontally across a central structure. Blue accent lighting illuminates the lower foreground, while a framed artwork glows under warm yellow light in a recessed upper niche. 1970, Photograph

item.title: Masked Figure with Scarf
item.description: Figure wearing a textured pink-and-green mask with white cat-eye glasses, photographed against a dark background. White fabric scarf drapes over the shoulders, contrasting with a black garment beneath. 1970, Photograph

item.title: Design: Electrical Gulf Cart
item.description: Scaled technical rendering of an electric golf cart shown from the front, dated 10/76 and attributed to designer Jeff Neumann. Watercolor and ink on drafting paper depicts two upholstered seats, a steering wheel, yellow headlights, and a dimensional annotation of 19 inches width. 1976, Painting

item.title: Untitled (Portrait, Upward Gaze)
item.description: Portrait photograph of a figure wearing dark sunglasses, a black t-shirt, and a white scarf wrapped at the neck. Face is tilted upward against a muted blue-grey background, with directional light casting shadow across the jaw and cheek. 1970, Photograph

item.title: Floydband Burped and Puked
item.description: Mixed-media collage featuring a central photographic scene of figures surrounding mannequin heads, overlaid with iridescent rainbow lettering spelling 'FLOYDBAND' and handwritten psychedelic text reading 'Burped and Puke Game All My Nose.' Three-dimensional cut-out letters spelling 'FLOYDBAND' appear on the left spine against a hot-pink ground. 1990, Collage

item.title: Untitled (Foil and Light)
item.description: Installation or studio view dominated by crumpled silver foil draped over LED or pixel-grid panels emitting blue, magenta, and green light. Suspended bare bulb glows blue at left; reflective honeycomb-patterned surfaces create layered iridescent zones across the lower half. 1970, Photograph

item.title: Untitled (Studio Group Shot)
item.description: Group of approximately seven figures gathered on a studio floor, one person mid-motion above the group. Posters and artworks cover the walls behind them, including a large marine-themed image; clothing hangs on a rack to the right. 1970, Photograph

item.title: Untitled (Installation View) 3
item.description: Installation view of a red-saturated gallery or studio space featuring iridescent silver-gold panels, framed photographic portraits on the wall, and a dark sculptural figure in the foreground. Blue light illuminates the lower foreground, contrasting with warm amber and red ambient lighting throughout the space. 1970, Photograph

item.title: Untitled (Boat Interior Plan)
item.description: Top-down architectural floor plan of a small boat interior rendered in ink and watercolor wash. Seating, steering wheel, and storage compartments are labeled, including a handwritten annotation reading 'COOLER / STORAGE' at lower right. 1970, Collage

item.title: Untitled (Interference Rings)
item.description: Saturated yellow ground bears three horizontal bands of concentric interference rings rendered in red and green. Elliptical wave forms radiate outward from focal points, creating an optical moiré pattern across the picture plane. 1970, Photograph

item.title: Polaroid Self-Portrait
item.description: Heavily light-leaked large-format film self-portrait shows a figure holding a Polaroid Land Camera at face level, obscuring features. Saturated orange and yellow tones dominate, with visible sprocket holes along both vertical edges indicating medium-format or 35mm roll film. 1980, Photograph

item.title: Neon City Nocturne
item.description: Densely layered cityscape rendered in vivid neon hues depicts a sprawling nocturnal skyline beneath an orange-red sky with abstracted cloud forms. Foreground features horizontal grid-like structures in turquoise and gold, while illuminated building windows and colored light beams animate the urban scene. 1980, Painting

item.title: Untitled (Grid Over Architecture)
item.description: Ink-drawn grid overlays a rectangular panel bearing faint architectural imagery rendered in grey and white tones. Two circular forms appear at the lower edge of the composition, and gestural cross-hatching reinforces the grid structure throughout. 1970, Collage

item.title: City Under Laser Sky
item.description: Dense nocturnal cityscape rendered in vivid neon colors, with illuminated skyscrapers spanning the full width of the composition. Radiating laser beams cross a red-orange sky above a suspended conical lamp, with dark cloud forms silhouetted against the fiery upper register. 1980, Painting

item.title: Stacked Painted Blocks 2
item.description: Hundreds of painted concrete or foam blocks in varied geometric forms — cubes, cylinders, arches — are stacked floor-to-ceiling in dense, grid-like layers. Colors span the full spectrum, with blue, orange, red, and pink predominating across the tightly packed composition. 1970, Sculpture

item.title: Projection onto Face
item.description: Double-exposure or projection photograph showing a human profile submerged beneath layered imagery of illuminated architectural or vehicular interiors. Blue, orange, and iridescent light bands obscure the upper face, leaving only the chin and neck visible against a deep black ground. 1970, Photograph
